purpose: Estimate whether one-frame movement preferences persist under different subsequent policy randomness. Not a learned-policy quality evaluation.
selection: Lowest TRAIN seed per each of4maps from the accepted dataset. No alternative outcome selection; development and confirmation excluded.
intervention: Same original context frameF, movement mean shifts and Gaussian/fire draws. Fork randomness only at F+1. Prefix, state and intervention-frame draws must match the accepted original context.
fork_contract: diagnostic_continuation_probe combat_policy_continuation_rng_fork_v1: first life only, exact fork_frameF+1, declared nonnegative31-bit seed. Reset main sampling PRNG once; use this seed for subsequent frame-hash aim choices. No NN/std changes, no reset of temporal memory or game world RNG. Record post-fork Gaussian/fire draw receipts. Sample.sampling_seed remains initial episode seed; explicit receipt declares effective continuation seed.
controls: For each fork seed and context, a fork-only ordinary-source reference and zero-shift fork model must reproduce the full same trajectory. Separate no-fork source replays must reproduce the old ordinary baseline. Other movement variants share prefix/draws but may differ afterF as intended.
technical_smoke: Before full collection: one selected TRAIN context, fork-only reference plus zero-shift and one nonzero movement variant, then explicit native/CUDA/prefix/control acceptance. No fitting.
labels: Compare actual alive goals, deaths, kills, receivedHP and fixed observed utility4*alive_goal+0.25*kills-received/100-death with own same-fork control. Include original continuation as replicate0, clearly distinguished from newly forked streams. These are policy-randomness repeats in one fixed initial world, not independent environment seeds or expected Q proof.
analysis: Report per-action utility delta range/mean, useful frequency, sign changes beyond +/-0.05, and ranking agreement across continuations. No action or context replacement to improve stability; exclusions remain explicit. No predeclared learned winner or automatic fitting from these repeats.
